written_from: user prompt only (critic never sees the designer's reasoning or code)
rationale: Part must compile to a printable STL without errors.
Part must fit on a standard 256 mm home printer bed.
Must be at least large enough to engage a freezer door latch and be handled.
Must stay clip-sized and not exceed a plausible freezer latch envelope.
Walls at least 1.2 mm for PETG/PLA strength and flex durability.
Must have enough material to resist repeated latch loads.
Must not be an oversized solid block incompatible with a latch clip.
Must produce at least one solid part.
